bio.text: Gregg Amore has been Rhode Island Secretary of State since January 3, 2023, and is the Democratic nominee for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represented House District 65 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.
His career experience includes work as a teacher at East Providence High School and as athletic director for the East Providence School Department.
He holds a bachelor's degree in history from Providence College (1988) and a master's degree in public policy from New England College (2010).
